loans.title: Lent out
loans.deleteHint: The entry for {title} disappears from the history. The game itself stays.
loans.emptyOpen: Nothing is lent out right now.
loans.emptyHint: Lend a game from its detail page in the library.

locations.title: Places
locations.subtitle: Where your games are: rooms, furniture, shelves, boxes – nested as deep as you like.
locations.deleteHint: All places inside it are deleted too. The games stay in your library, just without a place.
locations.emptyHint: Start with a room, then add furniture, shelves or boxes inside it.
locations.generalHint: Name and kind of the place.
locations.parentHint: Where this place is. Places can be nested as deep as you like.

people.title: People
people.subtitle: Owners of copies and people you lend games to. They don't need an account.
people.deleteHint: Games owned by this person keep existing without an owner.
people.emptyHint: Add the people who own games in this library or borrow them.
people.loansHint: Games this person has borrowed right now.
people.noOpenLoans: Nothing lent to this person right now.

settings.title: Library settings
settings.generalHint: Name and description of this library.
settings.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
settings.membersHint: Share this library with other accounts.

roleHint.viewer: sees the collection and who owns what, and can build their own views – no contact details, prices or values; loans as set above.
roleHint.editor: can also add and change games, places and loans.

settings.removeHint: They lose access to this library.
settings.leaveHint: You lose access until the owner adds you again.
settings.publicHint: Anyone with the link can see the games – but no people, places, prices or notes.
settings.deleteHint: Deleting the library removes all games, places, people and loans in it. This can't be undone.
settings.deleteConfirmHint: Everything in this library is deleted for all members.
settings.importHint: Bring in a collection from another app. Nothing changes until you confirm.
settings.viewerLoansStatus: Only whether a game is lent
settings.viewerLoansHint: Viewers never see to whom or since when something is lent, contact details, prices or values. They do see who owns a game.
